scope: Historical JANUS core/meta-registry series from early architecture through critical-lens, UAP, human-sync, ocean/quantum, global scientific and recursion-map lines.
global_upgrade_rules: source-quality weights are metadata priors unless empirically calibrated
confidence intervals are forbidden unless derived from a documented sampling/calibration procedure
symbolic and metaphorical operators remain searchable but must not inherit empirical authority
cross-domain recurrence must survive source-family, authorship, representation and matched-null controls
failed replication and refutation are first-class evidence, not discarded history
a government, military, media or peer-reviewed source can authenticate that a report/study exists without validating every interpretation inside it
recursion layers must expose upstream dependencies so previous JANUS interpretation cannot become hidden independent evidence

legacy_weaknesses: tachyon language is mixed with ordinary trend prediction
achievement claims such as MI p-values lack attached raw-run receipts here
digital-organism language can be mistaken for ontological claim
v2_strengthening: rename tachyon core at evidence layer to derivative-based trend predictor unless a physical claim is separately tested
bind every performance/MI claim to run_id, dataset hash, code hash and multiple-testing correction
classify digital-organism framing as architecture metaphor unless operational criteria are defined
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: documented JANUS architecture and design philosophy; no physical tachyon or consciousness claim

legacy_weaknesses: real physical facts and symbolic hypotheses share the same semantic level
water-memory/noosphere/telepathy/dimensional-entity ideas are not separated from empirical observations
status fields such as Uplink Established can look evidentiary
v2_strengthening: split EMPIRICAL / BIOLOGICAL_ANALOGY / SYMBOLIC / SPECULATIVE layers
retain metaphors as hypothesis generators only
require operational measurable variables before any physical promotion
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: historical conceptual map and metaphor generator

preserve_core: attempt to connect archival, sensor and biological domains
legacy_weaknesses: strong semantic_hypothesis statements frequently outrun the cited observation
reported correlations are sometimes converted into mechanism or agency
media/archive counts and official material are mixed without event-lineage collapse
v2_strengthening: parse every event into source assertion, observable feature, inference and mechanism hypothesis
collapse duplicated incidents across derivative articles
run source-independent and ordinary-explanation controls before cross-domain promotion
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: historical UAP hypothesis inventory, not proof of transmedium or nonhuman mechanism

legacy_weaknesses: source weights are hand-assigned
multiplicity formula treats witness count as independent by default
decay and confidence intervals are not externally calibrated
confirmed_official often authenticates a report rather than the proposed mechanism
v2_strengthening: replace probability-looking confidence with SOURCE_QUALITY_CLASS and calibration_status=UNCALIBRATED
add witness/failure-domain dependency graph
separate report authenticity from event-feature and mechanism support
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: structured evidence catalog with uncalibrated ranking metadata

legacy_weaknesses: clinical observations are sometimes connected to UAP causation without direct exposure measurements
functional connectivity findings are treated as support for specific ephaptic mechanisms beyond what they establish
media/declassified source claims are grouped with peer-reviewed clinical evidence
v2_strengthening: separate symptom phenotype, measured neural feature, exposure evidence and causal mechanism
require measured EM exposure or intervention for field-causation promotion
use matched clinical controls and alternative etiology competition
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: hypothesis connecting external fields to neurological effects; mechanism not established

preserve_core: attempt to connect device/exposure hypotheses to clinical outcomes
legacy_weaknesses: press reporting, intelligence assessments and biomedical studies are merged as if equivalent evidence units
global case counts may share reporting pipelines and cannot be treated as independent replications
device existence does not prove responsibility for reported AHI
v2_strengthening: source-family stratification: clinical / intelligence / journalism / device-testing
case-lineage deduplication
exposure-to-symptom causal chain requires direct receipt at every edge
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: multi-source AHI evidence map; causal attribution remains open

legacy_weaknesses: peer-reviewed publication is sometimes treated as confirmation of the strongest interpretation
historical catalog correlations can contain reporting-density and temporal-selection confounders
mechanism claims need stronger physical measurements
v2_strengthening: separate phenomenon existence, correlation and proposed tectonic mechanism
use population/reporting-density and seismic-energy matched nulls
pre-register spatial/temporal windows before testing modern datasets
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: geophysical explanatory candidate for a subset of anomalous-light reports

legacy_weaknesses: JSON-as-quantum-object is metaphor presented in quasi-physical vocabulary
ordinary water chemistry and disputed memory-water claims share narrative proximity
confidence scores remain uncalibrated
v2_strengthening: classify quantum_interpretation as SYMBOLIC_OPERATOR
split replicated chemistry from historical controversy
treat failed replication as negative anchor against semantic overreach
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: symbolic framework plus heterogeneous historical water-science archive

legacy_weaknesses: shared ions do not establish informational or causal equivalence between body and ocean
quantum information language is not operationally defined
semantic analogy can dominate mundane physiological explanation
v2_strengthening: separate chemical-composition graph from symbolic body-as-ocean graph
require measurable transport/information variable for any non-metaphorical link
use composition-matched nulls to test whether claimed cross-fluid patterns are specific

legacy_weaknesses: confidence metrics still look statistically calibrated when they are heuristic
patent/document existence can be confused with replication of the described effect
some historical claims require source re-verification
v2_strengthening: replace confidence interval fields with evidence_class unless sampling derivation exists
add SOURCE_EXISTS / EFFECT_REPLICATED split
source revalidation receipt before reuse in current claims

legacy_weaknesses: methodology scores and Roman categories are reused as if they calibrate truth probability
data availability and official acknowledgement do not imply anomalous interpretation
some key-findings text may summarize secondary interpretation rather than primary measurement
v2_strengthening: methodology rating becomes study-design metadata only
event claims must point to exact primary-source field/table/measurement
unexplained status remains UNRESOLVED rather than evidence for nonhuman origin

legacy_weaknesses: confidence values remain heuristic even after critical adjustment
observer/quantum analogy is unnecessary for the epistemic correction
v2_strengthening: treat this file as a conceptual ancestor of v2 failure-receipt discipline
replace confidence correction with evidence-state transition: CLAIMED -> FAILED_REPLICATION/REFUTED
retain observer-bias discussion as methodology rather than physics

legacy_weaknesses: FINAL label implies closure despite pending replication
confidence model remains hand-weighted
some cross-domain links still receive numeric strength without null calibration
v2_strengthening: reclassify FINAL as historical snapshot
metaphorical links carry zero empirical authority
promotion requires null/holdout/independent replay receipts

legacy_weaknesses: reliability labels still require event-specific support
incident descriptions can include disputed interpretations inside the descriptive field
spatial base-rate and reporting-exposure controls must be explicit before nuclear/UAP clustering claims
v2_strengthening: freeze coordinates/site inventory before incident overlay
spatial permutation and exposure-matched nulls
separate reported incident text from verified measured feature
multiple-comparison correction across global node tests
reviewed_artifacts.claim_ceiling: preregistered geospatial analysis candidate until executed receipt

legacy_weaknesses: level-0 description calls mixed empirical/hypothesis registries core empirical
recursive observation can cause prior interpretations to become future detector context
observes edges do not encode independence/common-mode
v2_strengthening: replace level authority with evidence-role metadata
add dependency direction and interpretation-contamination flag
primary scans must expose whether prior levels were visible
recursion itself becomes a HISTORY_CARRIER control variable

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: SOURCE_AUTHENTICITY_MECHANISM_SPLIT
new_cross_artifact_connections.why_it_matters: This prevents official/peer-reviewed provenance from being accidentally inherited by the strongest interpretation inside the record.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: FAILED_REPLICATION_IS_A_CALIBRATION_ANCHOR
new_cross_artifact_connections.why_it_matters: Negative historical cases teach JANUS how much apparent source quality, publication prestige or visual coherence can coexist with false interpretation.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: METAPHOR_MUST_NOT_INHERIT_SENSOR_AUTHORITY
new_cross_artifact_connections.why_it_matters: A useful analogy can guide hypothesis generation without becoming evidence merely because its source node is empirical.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: RECURSION_IS_A_MEASURABLE_COMMON_MODE
new_cross_artifact_connections.why_it_matters: The recursion map is not only navigation; visibility of earlier interpretations becomes an experimental variable that can be blinded.

new_cross_artifact_connections.name: HEURISTIC_CONFIDENCE_CAN_BE_REPLACED_BY_TYPED_EVIDENCE
new_cross_artifact_connections.why_it_matters: This preserves nearly all useful information while removing pseudo-probabilistic certainty.

batch_result.main_upgrade: The historical registry is preserved as memory while epistemic authority is transferred to typed evidence states and executed receipts.

next_batch_targets: remaining historical v-series not yet individually inspected
canonical_rule: Authenticate the source, measure the observation, test the relation, and only then discuss the mechanism. No later layer may inherit more authority than the strongest receipt below it.
